Born in the Bas-Rhin, Alsace, 1807, with his wife Barbara Noullet of Altenstadt,
by Wissembourg. They settled in Seneca County, Ohio, by 1835; he died there in 1868 and is buried at Tiffin.
Barbara went west with the family to Barclay, Iowa.
Barbe Noullet was born at Altenstadt, beside Wissembourg in northern Alsace, in 1806,
daughter of Martin Noullet and Maria Elisabetha Aschbacher.
She married Dominique Fritz there on 14 February 1831, and by 1835 they were in Seneca County,
Ohio. Widowed in 1868, she followed her children west to Barclay Township, Black Hawk County,
Iowa, where she died on 23 January 1889.
Her Iowa burial record gives her birthplace as “Wiesenburg”.
